name: model-compare
description: A green dot beside the prompt: click it and two gateway models answer the same prompt, side by side.

showDot.title: Show the green dot
showDot.description: Draw the green dot beside the prompt hint; clicking it opens the comparison and runs it.

rightModel.title: Second model
rightModel.description: The model id the right column starts with. Empty remembers the last one used.

paneRows.title: Pane height
paneRows.description: Rows the compare pane asks for while seated inline above the prompt.

maxTokens.title: Reply token cap
maxTokens.description: The most tokens one reply may take.

timeoutSeconds.title: Call timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds one model call may take before it is reported as timed out.
